notes.title: Lacuna Passage - Now on Steam Early Access
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9260568/d2111bc261105d0517d1ed6068a3a3c870e07c5b.gif[/img]

Random Seed Games is proud to present our ambitious Mars exploration and survival game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/252090/Lacuna_Passage/]Lacuna Passage - now available on Steam Early Access[/url]!

Explore the vast terrains of Mars, generated from real NASA satellite data, and survive by discovering randomized supply caches and habitats. Adventure in an otherworldly first-person sandbox.

We've got big plans to continue supporting and updating the game based on your suggestions and input. Hope you will join us on the Red Planet!

notes.title: TIMEframe Engine Update
notes.content:
Today we are releasing an update for TIMEframe that should bring improved performance for some users and will help us to potentially add VR in the future. We have also fixed several old bugs that a small percentage of players were experiencing. Check the full changelog below.

[list]
[*]Upgraded to Unity 5.3 (from 4.5)
[*]Updated shaders
[*]The start button on controllers should now work for all players to enable controller support
[*]Fixed some terrain collision errors
[*]Fixed a save loading bug
[*]Vsync option (can disable for 60+ FPS)
[/list]

notes.title: Full Controller Support
notes.content:
If you have an Xbox controller you should now be able to play the entire game (including navigating menus and reading previously collected artifact texts) with just the controller. This is step one towards potentially adding VR support in the near future. If you have more ideas for improvements we could make to the game let us know in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/340270/discussions/0/535150948609627480/]forum discussion[/url]!

Thanks!
Tyler Owen
Random Seed Games
